source_followup.cyt.2010.2.7: The point T is described only as an intersection with the circle, without naming the intersecting line. Verify the missing definition against the official source before editing the statement.
source_followup.cyt.2019.3.9: The coefficient domain and degree of P are unspecified. With real coefficients and no degree bound, interpolation permits arbitrarily many integer arguments with value 2019 and another with value zero, so there is no largest kappa. Check whether integer coefficients or another restriction were omitted.
source_followup.cyt.2021.1.3: The stated domain is N_0, but the identity is quantified for all m,n in N_0 and includes f(n-m), undefined when n<m. Check the intended domain or an omitted n>=m restriction.
source_followup.frt.2017.4.11: The variables are arbitrary real numbers and may all be zero, making the displayed ratios undefined. Check the intended nonzero or positive domain; Croatia HMO 2017 first round problem 1 states the related minimax problem for positive real numbers.
source_followup.frt.2020.4.12: The function is defined only on positive integers, but a and b are quantified as all integers with a+b>=C. This permits nonpositive arguments of f. Check whether a,b should be positive integers.
